# Auto-generated schematic symbols
import sys
import os

# Get project path and import kicad schematic interface
PROJECT_PATH = os.environ['PROJECT_PATH']
sys.path.append(PROJECT_PATH)
from modules.kicad_sch_interface import *

# ------------------------------
# Placing center symbol 1 : LM358 (U1)
# ------------------------------
center_x_1, center_y_1 = 150.0, 150.0

add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Amplifier_Operational",
    symbol_name="LM358",
    pos_x=center_x_1,
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="U1",
    value="LM358",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# ------------------------------
# Placing other symbols in the Schematic with respect to the center symbol 1
# ------------------------------
# R1 : 1N4148 diode
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Diode",
    symbol_name="1N4148",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + (-30),
    pos_y=center_y_1 + (0),
    reference="R1",
    value="1N4148",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# R2 : 1N4148 diode
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Diode",
    symbol_name="1N4148",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + (-60),
    pos_y=center_y_1 + (0),
    reference="R2",
    value="1N4148",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# ------------------------------
# Connecting all wires in the Schematic
# ------------------------------
# Connect U1 pin V- (pin 4) to R1 pin K (pin 1)
connect_pins("U1", "V-", "R1", "K")

# Connect R1 pin K (pin 1) to R2 pin K (pin 1)
connect_pins("R1", "K", "R2", "K")

write_out_all_wires()
